raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- DeepSeek-style MLA models (DeepSeek V2/V3, Kimi) run chunked-prefix MHA when a prefill batch has cached prefixes; prefix keys are attended in chunks of at most `SGLANG_MAX_KV_CHUNK_CAPACITY` (`C`) keys.
- Today every chunk gives every request the same `C // batch_size` keys. When a batch mixes one long prefix with short or empty ones, most of each chunk is wasted, and the longest prefix alone sets the chunk count: `ceil(max_prefix / (C // bs))`.
- Cost: prefixes `[350000, 15000, 7495, 0]` with `C = 65536` take 22 chunks per layer, while the 372,495 cached keys fit in 6.
- This PR changes the layout on ROCm only; every other platform keeps today's layout and chunk metadata.

## Modifications

- `test: make the manual prefix chunk info test run again`: `test/manual/attention/test_prefix_chunk_info.py` failed on main (fake backend without `runner_ids`, no published config). It now publishes a default config and uses a real non-translating `RunnerIds`.
- New `model_executor/forward_batch_deepseek_mha_rocm.py`:
  - `get_num_packed_prefix_chunks`, `get_packed_prefix_chunk_seq_lens`.
  - All cached prefixes are laid end to end in request order; chunk `i` holds keys `[i*C, (i+1)*C)` of that sequence.
  - Output keeps the existing per-request `(start, length)` shape, `(num_prefix_chunks, batch_size)` int32.
- `prepare_chunked_prefix_cache_info` (shared mixin) picks the layout:

| Condition | Layout | `num_prefix_chunks` | `prefix_chunk_len` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Not HIP | request-major (unchanged) | `ceil(max_prefix / (C // bs))` | `C // bs` |
| `single_chunk` (fused prefix + extend), any platform | request-major (unchanged) | 1 | `max_prefix` |
| HIP, packing needs fewer chunks | packed | `ceil(sum_prefix / C)` | `C` |
| HIP, packing saves no chunk (e.g. equal prefixes) | request-major | `ceil(max_prefix / (C // bs))` | `C // bs` |

- Packing adds keyless rows to most chunks, and aiter on main runs such a chunk on the bf16 varlen fallback instead of the fp8 PS prefill, so HIP packs only when it saves chunks.

Consumers of the chunk metadata on HIP:

| Consumer | Status |
|---|---|
| Callers: DeepSeek-style `MHA_CHUNKED_KV(_ROCM)`, `sarvam_moe`, `dots3` | Same mixin |
| AITER (`init_mha_chunk_metadata`, `_forward_extend_prefix_chunk`), Triton gfx95 dense fp8 chunked path | Read per-request `prefix_chunk_seq_lens(_cpu)`, `prefix_chunk_cu_seq_lens`, `prefix_chunk_max_seq_lens`, `prefix_chunk_num_tokens`, `prefix_chunk_has_zero_kv`; no equal-start assumption, no read of `prefix_chunk_len` |
| Other HIP backends (wave, torch_native, flex, dsa/nsa) | Never reach chunked MHA with a prefix |
| DCP (AITER + DCP) | `filter_dcp_local_chunk_kv_indices`, `all_gather_kv_cache_for_dcp` already take arbitrary starts from `prefix_chunk_starts_cpu` |
| Prefill CUDA graph runner | Builds its own request-major metadata and sets `prefix_chunk_len`, so `prepare_chunked_prefix_cache_info` returns early |
| Zero-length rows | Already produced by short prefixes and handled via `prefix_chunk_has_zero_kv`; AITER varlen returns `out = 0`, `lse = -inf` for them. On main such chunks skip the asm fp8 prefill; #47035 runs them on it |

## Accuracy Tests

- The math does not change: every prefix key is still attended exactly once and per-chunk results are merged by LSE; only the grouping of keys into chunks changes.
- GSM8K A/B with the chunk capacity lowered so cached prefixes need several chunks: `sgl-eval 0.1.3 run gsm8k --load-preset-from-model-id moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --num-threads 32 --n-repeats 2` (full 1319 x 2; repeats hit the radix cache with prefixes of different lengths).

| Build | pass@1 (2 repeats) | Truncated | Errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| this PR (`d5903ec164`) | 97.46% | 0 | 0 |
| without it | 97.65% | 0 | 0 |

  - Within sampling noise. Setup: 8x MI355X, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, AgentX c4 layout (TP8, DCP1, Gluon MLA, DSpark block 5) with `MAX_RUNNING_REQUESTS=32` and `SGLANG_MAX_KV_CHUNK_CAPACITY=512`, simulated acceptance off. Build: `k3-agentx-pr-stack` @ `39d944c57d`, with and without this PR merged; ROCm/aiter stack @ `f9b5308b2`.
  - A measurement-only log line in the PR arm confirmed packing ran on every rank (2 uniform chunks -> 1 packed), but only a few times: sgl-eval's steady request stream mostly extends one request with a cached prefix at a time, where both layouts need the same number of chunks. So this A/B shows no regression on a live server; the tests below are the main evidence for the packed layout itself.

| Test | Device | Checks |
|---|---|---|
| `test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_forward_batch_deepseek_mha_rocm.py` (`base-a-test-cpu`) | CPU | Helpers cover each prefix token once and in order, every chunk but the last is full; non-HIP gives main's 22 chunks for the example above, HIP gives 6; HIP keeps request-major for equal prefixes (no keyless rows). |
| `test/manual/attention/test_prefix_chunk_info.py` | 1x MI355X | Packed tables where HIP packs, request-major otherwise; chunk KV indices from the GPU kernel vs a reference built from `req_to_token`. |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Per-layer chunked prefix attention time, one run, Kimi-K3 integration build (8x MI355X, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`), request-major vs packed layout for one extend batch:

| prefixes `[350000, 15000, 7495, 0]`, `C = 65536` | chunks per layer | time per layer |
|---|---:|---:|
| request-major (main) | 22 | 163.75 ms |
| packed (this PR) | 6 | 108.78 ms |

- The measurement predates moving the layout behind `_is_hip`; the packed path it timed is the one HIP now takes for this batch.
- That build also carries #47035, so chunks with keyless requests ran on the AITER asm fp8 prefill in both columns. Without #47035, AITER on main sends them to the bf16 varlen fallback, so this number does not carry over to main by itself.

Prefill end to end:

| Setup | Value |
|---|---|
| Hardware / model | 8x MI355X, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, TP8, DCP 1, DSpark block 3 with real acceptance |
| Build | Kimi-K3 integration build (`k3-agentx-c56` plus the open K3 PRs), AITER `6ae4bf0f2` (`yuychang/aiter` `k3-agentx-c56`), ROCm 7.2.4 |
| A/B | Integration build vs the same build with only this change reverted |
| Workload | `bench_serving` `generated-shared-prefix`, 32 groups x 8 prompts, 16K shared prefix, 1K question, 256 output, concurrency 16; one unrecorded warm-up, then 3 passes with the cache flushed before each |

| | Reverted | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| Mean TTFT | 1,322 ms | 1,324 ms |

- No difference, as expected: these prompts share one 16K prefix and rarely need more than one chunk. Two servers with identical code differ by up to about 2.5% in mean TTFT on this workload.
- Other platforms are not affected: the layout change is gated on HIP.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""ROCm prefix-chunk layout for DeepSeek chunked-prefix MHA.
+
+All cached prefixes are laid end to end in request order, and chunk i holds keys
+[i * C, (i + 1) * C) of that sequence, so a short or empty prefix leaves its share
+of a chunk to the long ones. The shared request-major layout gives every request
+C // batch_size keys per chunk, so the longest prefix alone sets the chunk count.
+"""
+
+from typing import List, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+
+def get_num_packed_prefix_chunks(
+    *, prefix_lens_cpu: List[int], chunk_capacity: int
+) -> int:
+    return (sum(prefix_lens_cpu) + chunk_capacity - 1) // chunk_capacity
+
+
+# Drop-in for get_prefix_chunk_seq_lens with prefix_chunk_len = chunk capacity;
+# outputs are (num_prefix_chunks, batch_size) int32 starts and lengths.
+def get_packed_prefix_chunk_seq_lens(
+    prefix_lens: torch.Tensor, num_prefix_chunks: int, prefix_chunk_len: int
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    prefix_lens = prefix_lens.to(torch.int64)
+    offsets = torch.cumsum(prefix_lens, dim=0) - prefix_lens
+    chunk_begins = (
+        torch.arange(num_prefix_chunks, device=prefix_lens.device).unsqueeze(1)
+        * prefix_chunk_len
+    )
+    prefix_chunk_starts = torch.minimum(
+        (chunk_begins - offsets).clamp(min=0), prefix_lens
+    )
+    prefix_chunk_ends = torch.minimum(
+        (chunk_begins + prefix_chunk_len - offsets).clamp(min=0), prefix_lens
+    )
+    return (
+        prefix_chunk_starts.to(torch.int32),
+        (prefix_chunk_ends - prefix_chunk_starts).to(torch.int32),
+    )

+"""ROCm packed prefix-chunk layout: no chunk exceeds SGLANG_MAX_KV_CHUNK_CAPACITY keys,
+each prefix token is covered once and in order, and only HIP takes this layout."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+from unittest.mock import create_autospec
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.alloc.runner_ids import RunnerIds
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.router import PlainPoolRouter
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import MLATokenToKVPool
+from sglang.srt.model_executor import forward_batch_deepseek_mha_mixin as mix
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_deepseek_mha_rocm import (
+    get_num_packed_prefix_chunks,
+    get_packed_prefix_chunk_seq_lens,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import ForwardContext, forward_context
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_mode import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_CASES = [
+    # (prefix_lens, chunk_capacity)
+    ([64, 64, 64], 48),
+    ([16, 32, 48, 64], 64),
+    ([1, 64], 31),
+    ([256, 0, 1536], 1024),
+    ([0, 0, 5], 4),
+    ([7], 7),
+    ([3, 5, 0, 9, 1], 6),
+]
+
+
+def _prepare(prefix_lens, capacity):
+    bs = len(prefix_lens)
+    fb = ForwardBatch(
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+        batch_size=bs,
+        input_ids=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.int64),
+        req_pool_indices=torch.arange(bs, dtype=torch.int64),
+        seq_lens=torch.tensor(prefix_lens, dtype=torch.int64) + 1,
+        out_cache_loc=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.int64),
+        seq_lens_sum=sum(prefix_lens) + bs,
+    )
+    fb.extend_prefix_lens = torch.tensor(prefix_lens, dtype=torch.int32)
+    fb.extend_prefix_lens_cpu = list(prefix_lens)
+    fb.iteration_ids = object()
+
+    def pack(plan, *, req_pool_indices, seq_lens, indptr, out, kv_start_idx):
+        out.zero_()
+        return True
+
+    runner_ids = create_autospec(RunnerIds, instance=True)
+    runner_ids.reads_are_translated = True
+    runner_ids.pack_read_stream = pack
+    pool = create_autospec(MLATokenToKVPool, instance=True)
+    pool.start_layer, pool.layer_num = 0, 1
+    pool.layer_router = PlainPoolRouter(pool, "full")
+    backend = SimpleNamespace(
+        runner_ids=runner_ids,
+        token_to_kv_pool=pool,
+        req_to_token_pool=SimpleNamespace(req_to_token=torch.zeros((bs, 1))),
+    )
+    with (
+        envs.SGLANG_MAX_KV_CHUNK_CAPACITY.override(capacity),
+        forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=backend)),
+    ):
+        fb.prepare_chunked_prefix_cache_info(torch.device("cpu"))
+    return fb
+
+
+class TestPackedPrefixChunkLayout(CustomTestCase):
+    def _assert_valid_layout(self, prefix_lens, capacity, starts, seq_lens):
+        self.assertEqual(starts.shape, seq_lens.shape)
+        self.assertEqual(starts.shape[1], len(prefix_lens))
+        self.assertEqual(starts.dtype, torch.int32)
+        self.assertEqual(seq_lens.dtype, torch.int32)
+
+        # Each request's pieces tile [0, prefix_len) in chunk order.
+        for req, prefix_len in enumerate(prefix_lens):
+            covered = []
+            for chunk in range(starts.shape[0]):
+                start, length = int(starts[chunk, req]), int(seq_lens[chunk, req])
+                self.assertGreaterEqual(length, 0)
+                covered.extend(range(start, start + length))
+            self.assertEqual(covered, list(range(prefix_len)))
+
+        # Every chunk but the last is full and the last is not empty,
+        # so no layout needs more than ceil(sum / capacity) chunks.
+        totals = seq_lens.sum(dim=1).tolist()
+        self.assertTrue(all(total == capacity for total in totals[:-1]))
+        self.assertTrue(0 < totals[-1] <= capacity)
+
+    def test_packed_layout_covers_each_prefix_token_once_within_capacity(self):
+        for prefix_lens, capacity in _CASES:
+            with self.subTest(prefix_lens=prefix_lens, capacity=capacity):
+                starts, seq_lens = get_packed_prefix_chunk_seq_lens(
+                    prefix_lens=torch.tensor(prefix_lens, dtype=torch.int32),
+                    num_prefix_chunks=get_num_packed_prefix_chunks(
+                        prefix_lens_cpu=prefix_lens, chunk_capacity=capacity
+                    ),
+                    prefix_chunk_len=capacity,
+                )
+                self._assert_valid_layout(prefix_lens, capacity, starts, seq_lens)
+
+    def test_only_hip_packs_long_and_short_prefixes_together(self):
+        # Request-major chunks give each request capacity // batch_size keys,
+        # so the longest prefix alone needs 22 of them here.
+        prefix_lens, capacity = [350000, 15000, 7495, 0], 65536
+
+        with mock.patch.object(mix, "_is_hip", False):
+            fb = _prepare(prefix_lens, capacity)
+        self.assertEqual(fb.num_prefix_chunks, 22)
+        self.assertEqual(fb.prefix_chunk_len, capacity // len(prefix_lens))
+        expected_starts = [[i * fb.prefix_chunk_len] * 4 for i in range(22)]
+        self.assertEqual(fb.prefix_chunk_starts.tolist(), expected_starts)
+
+        with mock.patch.object(mix, "_is_hip", True):
+            fb = _prepare(prefix_lens, capacity)
+        self.assertEqual(fb.num_prefix_chunks, 6)
+        self.assertEqual(fb.prefix_chunk_len, capacity)
+        self._assert_valid_layout(
+            prefix_lens, capacity, fb.prefix_chunk_starts, fb.prefix_chunk_seq_lens
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.prefix_chunk_starts_cpu, fb.prefix_chunk_starts))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(fb.prefix_chunk_seq_lens_cpu, fb.prefix_chunk_seq_lens)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [len(indices) for indices in fb.prefix_chunk_kv_indices],
+            fb.prefix_chunk_seq_lens.sum(dim=1).tolist(),
+        )
+
+    def test_hip_keeps_request_major_when_packing_saves_no_chunk(self):
+        # Equal prefixes need 4 chunks either way; packing would only add keyless
+        # rows, which keep aiter off its fp8 PS prefill.
+        prefix_lens, capacity = [64, 64, 64], 48
+        with mock.patch.object(mix, "_is_hip", True):
+            fb = _prepare(prefix_lens, capacity)
+        self.assertEqual(fb.num_prefix_chunks, 4)
+        self.assertEqual(fb.prefix_chunk_len, capacity // len(prefix_lens))
+        self.assertFalse(any(fb.prefix_chunk_has_zero_kv))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
